claim.claim-text: 2. The method of claim 1, further comprising: identifying, in the source code, one or more call expressions that each represent a logging call.
3. The method of claim 2, wherein identifying the one or more call expressions comprises traversing one or more abstract syntax trees for the one or more software packages.

4. The method of any of claims 1-3, wherein generating the number of search patterns comprises applying string parsing logic to a string representing the corresponding call expression, the string parsing logic to identify a function call and one or more parameters in the one or more arguments of the corresponding call expression.
5. The method of any of claims 1-4, wherein the search patterns comprise regular expressions.
6. The method of any of claims 1-5, wherein a log entry component that applies the search patterns to the output messages produced by the one or more software packages is configured to:

receive an output message produced by the one or more software packages during execution; and iteratively compare the output message to each search pattern in an ordered list of the number of search patterns until a match is found, wherein the ordered list is arranged based on how often each search pattern has a matching output message.
7. The method of claim 6, wherein the log entry component is further configured to:
convert the output message to a structured format; and provide the message to a central repository.
8. A system comprising: one or more processors configured to perform the method of any of claims 1-7.
9. A computer readable medium storing instructions that, when executed by one or more processors, cause the one or more processors to perform the method of any of claims 1-7.
